screen: LMS — Build / Assign / Deliver: Course Builder (create-course-page), Learning Assignment & Enrollment (learning-assignments), Learning Delivery "My Learning" (learning-delivery-workspace) and Course Authoring sheets (course-authoring)
screenLevelGaps: CUSTOMER SUSPICION CONFIRMED — there are THREE course-creation paths, not two. (1) Course Builder wizard at /module/lms/administration/course-builder (content-map-m4.ts:18), (2) Catalog 'New Course' -> CourseFormSheet (learning-catalog.tsx:363), (3) Catalog 'Build with AI' -> AiCourseController@publish (AiCourseController.php:492). All three POST the same endpoint /api/lms/courses and write the same sub_std_map row, but only the wizard sends the `settings` and `prerequisites` blocks. Field divergence: CourseFormSheet has short_name + sort_order + an explicit Active switch which the wizard lacks; the wizard has description, duration, language, mandatory, discussion, visibility, prerequisites, passing score, max attempts, certificate template, re-cert alerts, enrollment rule, department/role restrictions and availability dates which CourseFormSheet lacks entirely. The AI path sends none of them.

WHERE THE SUSPICION IS WRONG — editing a course from the catalog does NOT wipe the builder's settings. LmsCourseController::saveSettings/savePrerequisites are both guarded by `if (!$request->has('settings'))` / `has('prerequisites')` (LmsCourseController.php:151, 211), so a CourseFormSheet PUT leaves lms_course_settings and lms_course_prerequisites untouched. The two paths coexist safely on that specific axis.

The Course Builder can never re-open an existing course. `lmsCourseBuilderService.load()` (course-builder.ts:180) is defined but is called from nowhere, useCourseBuilder always starts from EMPTY_FORM (use-course-builder.ts:144), and the route has no :id segment (content-map-m4.ts:18). 'Save as Draft' therefore produces a status=0 course that can only ever be edited afterwards through the catalog's simple sheet — which cannot touch modules, assessments, prerequisites or any settings field.

BREAKS THE PLAYER — the builder's lesson URL is silently discarded. use-course-builder.addContent posts `{chapter_id,title,file_type,url}` (course-builder.ts:277-292) but LmsLearningController@storeContent validates and inserts only `filename` and never reads or writes `url` (LmsLearningController.php:804-851). content_master.filename stays NULL, so LessonViewer falls into the `if (!src)` branch and every lesson authored in the wizard renders 'This lesson has no attached media.' (learning-delivery-workspace.tsx:242).

Content kinds are incompatible between builder and player. The builder writes file_type = video|document|scorm|session (create-course-page.tsx:57-62); the player's lessonKind() only understands mp4/video, pdf, jpg/jpeg/png/image and link/url (learning-delivery-workspace.tsx:65-72). 'document', 'scorm' and 'session' all fall through to 'unknown'. There is no SCORM/xAPI/AICC runtime anywhere in either repo, and 'Live Session' creates no lms_virtual_classroom row — the LMSFeatures spec's 'SCORM, video, PDF, quizzes, AICC/xAPI support' is not met.

EIGHT builder settings are write-only with zero readers anywhere in either repo: settings.is_mandatory, discussion_enabled, duration_minutes, language, description, passing_score, max_attempts, recert_alerts. Verified by grepping app/ and the whole frontend — the only hits are the writer (LmsCourseController::saveSettings) and a comment in LmsAssessmentController.php:27. The 'Mandatory Course' checkbox's own helper text promises 'Automatically assign and enforce completion rules'; nothing auto-assigns anything.

NO SKILLS-TO-COURSE MAPPING. LMSFeatures explicitly requires 'someone needs to tag LMS courses with which skills/competencies they build, or our auto-recommendation engine has nothing to point to.' Neither create-course-page nor course-form-sheet has any skill/competency field. lms_certificates.skill_id is inferred at issue time from the legacy polymorphic sub_std_map.subject_id (LmsLearningController.php:965-984), a column no creation path in the new frontend can set. LMS therefore cannot declare what capability it builds — the ownership model's 'LMS = BUILD skill' link is severed at the source.

ASSIGN DOES NOT REACH THE LEARNER. assignmentController@store inserts into lms_assignments only (assignmentController.php:183-199). LmsLearningController@courses — the sole feed for the My Learning picker — reads lms_course_enroll only (LmsLearningController.php:81-104). A course pushed via 'Assign Learning' therefore never appears in the assignee's My Learning. The assign->deliver chain is broken.

COMPLETION FEEDS NOTHING. LmsLearningController@saveProgress writes only lms_content_progress (LmsLearningController.php:329-366). It never updates lms_assignments.progress/status, never updates lms_course_enroll, and never writes s_skill_matrix. Grep confirms only assignmentController and Competency/LearningAssignmentController write lms_assignments. So the Assignment Queue's Progress column and Status stay at 0%/'Not Started' forever, and Competency's DevelopmentPlanController (line 204) reads that same table to report plan completion.

Course completion is only recorded if the learner claims a certificate. lms_course_enroll.status='completed' is written in exactly one place — issueCertificate (LmsLearningController.php:1494-1499). A learner who finishes every lesson but never clicks 'Claim certificate' is 100% in the player yet still 'In Progress' on the catalog completion rate, the KPI tiles and the Enrollments tab. No completed_at column is written at all.

Approving an enrolment request grants nothing. review()/bulkReview() flip lms_assignments.approval_status (assignmentController.php:415, 466) but create no lms_course_enroll row, so the approved learner still has no course in My Learning.

Builder access rules are enforced on only one of two enrolment paths. checkEnrolmentEligibility (LmsCourseEnrollController.php:207-320) enforces availability window, visibility, department/role restriction, prerequisites and open-vs-approval — but only for learner self-enrol. assignmentController@store applies none of them, so an admin push bypasses every restriction the wizard configured, and CSV import does too.

SELECTION IS BY ROW INDEX, NOT ID. DataTable emits String(index) relative to the `data` prop (data-table.tsx:84-95, 155). Two consequences: (a) the Approval Queue's bulk Approve/Reject send `selectedIds.map(Number)` as assignment ids (learning-assignments.tsx:1075, 1084, 1120, 1129) — selecting the first row sends ids=[0], which matches no row, so bulk approval always reports '0 request(s) approved'; (b) handleBulkUpdate indexes `assignments[Number(idx)]` (use-assignments.ts:133) against the full filtered list while the table is fed the page slice `pagedAssignments` (learning-assignments.tsx:1230) — on page 2 and beyond the wrong assignments are updated. selectedIds is also a single shared state across all four tabs, so a selection leaks between them.

'Due Today' and 'Due This Week' quick filters always return zero rows. setQuickFilter writes the badge label into `filters.status` (use-assignments.ts:170-172) and filteredAssignments then rejects any row whose progress status !== 'Due Today' (use-assignments.ts:187). No lms_assignments.status value is ever 'Due Today'/'Due This Week'.

Four sidebar filters are inert: Department and Assigned By are hardcoded to a single 'All' option (learning-assignments.tsx:1437, 1456) so nothing can be selected; Learning Type and Due Date are stored in filter state but never referenced in filteredAssignments (use-assignments.ts:184-209). 'Apply Filters' only re-issues the search term — the working filters already apply on every keystroke.

ASSESSMENTS ARE UNTAKEABLE. The builder creates question_paper rows with zero questions (no question picker is wired — lmsCourseBuilderService.questionBank and updateAssessment are defined but called from nowhere), and the player's Assessments tab is pure read-only markup with no Start/Attempt control (learning-delivery-workspace.tsx:432-510). There is no /api route that submits an attempt; the only lms_online_exam writers are CSRF-protected web controllers in routes/lms.php. A quiz built in the wizard can never be sat from the new frontend.

The Course Builder wipes columns on every save after the first. buildPayload omits short_name, sort_order and proficiency (use-course-builder.ts:283-314) while LmsCourseController@update writes `$request->short_name`, `$request->sort_order`, `$request->proficiency` unconditionally (LmsCourseController.php:822-836). create sets sort_order to 1; the next goNext() save nulls it.

The course thumbnail can only be attached on the very first save. save() picks createWithImage only when courseId is null (use-course-builder.ts:350-359); every later save goes through update(), which is JSON-only and has no display_image handling (LmsCourseController@update has no hasFile branch). Adding a thumbnail after 'Save as Draft' is silently dropped.

Provenance is stripped in the UI. assignmentController@index deliberately selects a.source, a.competency_id and a.development_plan_id 'so an admin had no way to know that changing one also moves a competency plan' (assignmentController.php:81-91) — but the LmsAssignment TypeScript type (services/lms/assignment.ts:30-42) has none of those fields and no table column renders them. An LMS admin can bulk-mark a competency development-plan assignment Completed with no indication it belongs to Competency.

My Learning shows courses whose enrolment is still 'pending' approval. LmsLearningController@courses applies no status filter (LmsLearningController.php:86-104), so an approval-gated enrolment created by checkEnrolmentEligibility with status='pending' is fully playable while awaiting a decision.
The Discussions tab renders unconditionally (learning-delivery-workspace.tsx:1104) — settings.discussion_enabled is never consulted by the tab, the hook, or LmsLearningController@discussions.

Re-certification alerts, deadline reminders and drop-off/non-completion alerts (required by LMSFeatures for Employee and Department Head) have no implementation: recert_alerts is stored and never read, and app/Events, app/Listeners, app/Observers do not exist so there is no mechanism to hang them on.

Course versioning/archiving, bulk course upload, multi-language content, course expiry/re-certification cycles, and a rules engine for mandatory training — all named in LMSFeatures Admin — have no field, table or endpoint in any of these four screens.

Builder Category and Course Type selects only offer values already present in the tenant's catalog (toOptions(categories/types), fed by SELECT DISTINCT in LmsCourseController@filters). A fresh tenant sees empty dropdowns and cannot create the first category or type. CourseFormSheet solves the same problem with a free-text SuggestInput + datalist — the wizard is strictly less capable here.

Module rename is unreachable: useCourseBuilder exposes renameModule (use-course-builder.ts:436, 637) and the service exposes updateModule, but create-course-page never destructures or renders it. A mistyped module name can only be fixed by delete-and-recreate, which soft-deletes its lessons (LmsLearningController.php:783).
